nodes.title: SG-4.1.2 Lock phaser to 3.90.x in package-lock.json
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/package.json declares phaser ~3.90.0, but game/frontend/package-lock.json still records phaser ^4.2.1 in the root dependencies entry (L15) and version 4.2.1 under node_modules/phaser (L3445-L3453). Desired behavior: both entries use the resolved 3.90.0 release with its registry URL and integrity. Expected result: npm ci installs phaser 3.90.0. Why: the SG-4 Phaser 3.90 integration needs a reproducible install.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given package-lock.json, when packages[""].dependencies.phaser is read, then it equals ~3.90.0 and matches package.json
- Given package-lock.json, when packages["node_modules/phaser"] is read, then version is 3.90.0 with the 3.90.0 tarball URL and integrity


## Scope
- In scope: phaser root dependency entry in game/frontend/package-lock.json
- In scope: node_modules/phaser entry in game/frontend/package-lock.json
- Out of scope: package.json changes (already ~3.90.0)
- Out of scope: Phaser source code changes
- Out of scope: other dependencies
- Preserve: all other lockfile entries, including eventemitter3 5.0.4


## Technical constraints
- Phaser must stay on the 3.90.x line
- No network or Git credentials in the browser


## Definition of done
- Both lockfile entries point to phaser 3.90.0
- Lockfile unit tests pass


## Non-functional requirements
- Lockfile stays valid JSON, lockfileVersion 3


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Lockfile root dependencies entry declares phaser ~3.90.0
nodes.body:
Context: package-lock.json L15 reads "phaser": "^4.2.1", which disagrees with package.json L18 (~3.90.0). Desired behavior: the root entry equals the package.json specifier. Expected result: npm ci does not report lock/package mismatch. Why: a mismatched lock can install Phaser 4.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given package-lock.json, when the root dependencies.phaser is read, then it equals ~3.90.0
- Given package.json and the lockfile root, when phaser specifiers are compared, then they are identical


## Scope
- In scope: packages[""].dependencies.phaser
- Out of scope: node_modules/phaser entry
- Preserve: other root dependencies


## Technical constraints
- Specifier must be exactly ~3.90.0


## Definition of done
- Root entry reads ~3.90.0


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · node_modules/phaser lock entry resolves 3.90.0 with URL and integrity
nodes.body:
Context: node_modules/phaser (L3445-L3453) records 4.2.1. Desired behavior: version 3.90.0, resolved https://registry.npmjs.org/phaser/-/phaser-3.90.0.tgz, integrity sha512-/cziz/5ZIn02uDkC9RzN8VF9x3Gs3XdFFf9nkiMEQT3p7hQlWuyjy4QWosU802qqno2YSLn2BfqwOKLv/sSVfQ==, and dependencies eventemitter3 ^5.0.1 as published. Why: reproducible install of the 3.90 line.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the lockfile, when node_modules/phaser is read, then version is 3.90.0 and resolved is the phaser-3.90.0.tgz registry URL
- Given the lockfile, when node_modules/phaser integrity is read, then it equals the 3.90.0 sha512 value and its eventemitter3 range is satisfied by the locked 5.0.4


## Scope
- In scope: node_modules/phaser lockfile entry
- Out of scope: root dependencies entry
- Preserve: eventemitter3 5.0.4 entry
- Preserve: license field MIT


## Technical constraints
- Values must come from npm registry metadata for phaser@3.90.0


## Definition of done
- Entry matches registry metadata for 3.90.0


## Clarifying questions
- None
